text:
emma-support: FYI - BlueFjord (tenant bf-prod) reporting intermittent p95 token latency spikes (+ occasional 429s) on their Dedicated EU pool since ~2026-03-15. TL;DR: spikes line up with other pods on same node. Suspect noisy neighbor (MIG co-host). @marc-infra can you take a look? Link: https://redwood/dashboard/tenants/bf-prod

marc-infra: on it. Can you paste the API request IDs and the host/node ids? Also need MIG partition sizes for that node.

emma-support: pasted below. Request sample and allocator info:

emma-support: ```
req_id: rq_0b3f9a
ts: 2026-03-15T18:22:11Z
model: redwood/llama2-13b-8k
tokens: 1200
status: 200 then 429
node: eu-ded-04
mig: 1g.5gb
p95: 1.2s -> 3.9s
``` 

orch-bot: alert: node eu-ded-04 kernel reported GPU SM saturation at 2026-03-15T18:21:50Z, metric=gpu_sm_util=99% :warning:

marc-infra: I see co-located tenants on eu-ded-04: bf-prod (1x MIG 1g), acct-helix (2x MIG 1g), sandbox (1x MIG shared). Could be SM saturation. Did autoscale kick?

sara-ml: from model side: batch sizes didn't change, but client qps did spike ~x2 at that time. We have KV cache warmups but nothing unusual. Logs show repeated KV cache evictions with eviction_count ~1200.

noah-oncall: quick triage: can we repro by forcing load on acct-helix tenant in staging? If SM saturation reproduces, we can ask infra to migrate one MIG slice. Also check NVML metrics for L2 thrash and memory bandwidth.

marc-infra: running runbook step: checking topology and kernel affinity now. If noisy neighbor confirmed, options: 1) migrate acct-helix off node, 2) change MIG partitioning to 2x1g instead of 4x, 3) bump autoscale for bf-prod (short-term).

emma-support: customer prefers non-disruptive: ask for migration first. Also they reported an auth 401 during a retry loop around same time — could be token expiry coinciding with retries. I'll open a billing/auth ticket if we find repeated 401s.

marc-infra: migration scheduled in 15m. I'll attach the pre-migration logs. If migration reduces p95 -> confirms noisy neighbor. If not, we'll look at kernel scheduling and NVLink.

emma-support: thanks. I'll update customer. :thumbsup:

marc-infra: post-migration update (will post in 15m).
